title: Forge family bonds
intro: We will pick a birthday, choose all the cousins, and send one message to everyone.

steps.say: This chat is made up, and nothing is sent. Your assistant starts the conversation.
act: Good morning. Grandma has a birthday in 9 days. Want me to help?

steps.say: You answer in your own words.
act: Yes. Message all my cousins about a call for her.
Yes. Message all my cousins about a call for her.

steps.say: It drafts one message for you to check.
act: Here is a draft: "Hi everyone, Grandma's birthday is coming up. Want to do a video call with the whole family?"

steps.say: You press send once, and it goes to every cousin.
act: Sent to 4 cousins (demo). You are a little closer, in about a minute.
